method: Visual review of the saved crop image against its inline verified reference. Exclude from paired OCR-versus-clean NER metrics only when the crop visibly includes neighboring text or the reference covers text outside the crop. This is a development-only scope control; it does not alter the annotations or page images. One corrected region was recropped and OCR-checked; its updated box now covers only the reference sentence. Two Washington Daily News article crops were retightened and OCR-checked; their text now covers the reference story without the previously included neighboring material. The Cordele Stafford/Ingram region was confirmed against its reference, which contains both adjacent social notes, and was restored to the paired set.
